definitions: A projecting frame with a float, attached to the side of a canoe or other boat to prevent it from capsizing.
A projecting spar or beam, especially one used to extend a mast or provide support.
A projecting part of a structure or machine, often for stabilization or support.
examples: The Polynesian canoe featured a sturdy outrigger.
They extended the crane with an outrigger.
The outrigger provided extra stability to the platform.
